about: The burner set to hold the return, working on a return that stays under the setpoint - and at second 901 the socket that played the return is let go, so the role reads nothing from then on. The last number is the one of second 900; ten periods of the round (2 s) and at least 30 s later the return is silent too long and the fire is burnt off, naming the return. The boiler goes on reading all the while.
